h2: NDT training near Pasadena, Texas: San Jacinto College, Ship Channel employers and online study compared

NDT training near Pasadena, Texas: San Jacinto College, Ship Channel employers and online study compared

Unlike much of Texas, Pasadena has a public NDT programme inside the city: San Jacinto College teaches nondestructive testing at its Central Campus, a short drive from the Ship Channel refineries and chemical plants that employ inspection crews. Around it sit private NDT and welding-inspection schools in Houston, ASNT's own testing site in Clear Lake, and inspection companies that hire assistants straight onto plant work. Here is how a Pasadena candidate can weigh them.

Who offers NDT training around Pasadena?

  • San Jacinto College, Central Campus. Three stackable NDT credentials: a two-term Certificate of Technology of 29 credits covering visual, magnetic particle, liquid penetrant and ultrasonic testing; a four-term Level 2 Certificate of 45 credits that the college says spans more than a dozen methods; and a 60-credit AAS of about two years. The same campus runs Fixed Equipment Inspection Technology, with courses on pressure vessels, piping and valves, and welding inspection that prepare for API 510, API 570 and the AWS CWI exam; the college points out that those API exams also demand years of industry experience.
  • Lone Star College, North Harris and East Aldine. An Inspection Technology specialisation with Certificate Level I, Certificate Level II and an AAS, on the north side of Houston. The programme page names no specific methods, so ask which ones you will handle.
  • Universal Technical Institute, Houston. UTI lists a nine-month NDT programme at its Houston campus covering VT, MT, ET, RT, UT and PT.
  • Tulsa Welding School, Houston campus. An AAS in Welding Inspection and Quality Management for welders moving toward inspection; it centres on codes and inspection procedures rather than named NDT methods.
  • ASNT Houston, Clear Lake. The society's training and testing site at 912 Gemini Street offers classroom and certification-prep courses and holds ASNT NDT Level II and III, ASNT 9712 and IRRSP radiation-safety exams by appointment.
  • Assistant jobs on the Ship Channel. A 2026 XCEL NDT posting for NDE assistants covering the Pasadena, Beaumont and Port Arthur areas offered on-the-job and classroom training toward a technician role, and asked for a current TWIC card, a background check and drug screen, site safety council training, and the ability to climb scaffolding more than 100 feet up in heat and cold.
  • ASNT Greater Houston Section. The local section listed by ASNT, where Pasadena candidates can meet Level IIIs from the plants and contractors along the channel.

Which Pasadena route fits you?

Your situationRoute that usually fitsWhat to watch
No NDT job yet, able to study for a term or moreSan Jacinto's Certificate of Technology, then the Level 2 Certificate or AASCredit load against work hours
Ready to work nowAn NDE assistant job with a TWIC card, with theory studied alongsidePhysical demands and documenting your classroom hours
Technician adding UT or a Level IIOnline theory plus a practical at your contractor or plantAcceptance under your employer's written practice
Plant or contractor certifying a crew before a turnaroundOn-site training with Level III-run examsTiming the exams so the crew is certified before mobilisation

Questions to ask any NDT training provider near Pasadena

  • Method hours. Are classroom hours listed by method and level against SNT-TC-1A's recommendations? Check them with the hours planner.
  • Plant-relevant practice. Will you scan pipe welds, corroded plate and nozzle areas like those in Pasadena units, or only flat test blocks?
  • Who certifies. San Jacinto, a private school or Atlantis can give you training; a Ship Channel employer certifies you, or ASNT does after its central exams.
  • Site access. Does the job you are aiming for need a TWIC card and a safety council orientation before day one?
  • Level III support. Can you reach an ASNT NDT Level III with questions, and who grades the practical?

Where Atlantis fits for Pasadena candidates and employers

The Atlantis route has no Pasadena classroom and needs none. Theory is studied online on the Atlantis portal around twelve-hour shifts and turnaround rotations, an ASNT NDT Level III answers questions, and access starts the day you enrol. Practice comes in the Practical NDT simulator, and the hands-on practical and exam run at your employer's own facility under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, with the employer issuing the certification. For Ship Channel work the usual pair is ultrasonic testing training and magnetic particle testing training, reached through Level 1 and Level 2; self-test with the free practice tests.

A San Jacinto student can also run the online theory alongside college labs to reach Level II sooner once hired. Weld inspectors can look at the six-day AWS CWI exam prep for the Houston area. Nearby pages: Houston, Deer Park and Baytown.
